name: inkling-tests
description: Inkling: the app is built from src/ into index.html by build.js (no runtime dependencies). These are the build, test and formatting tools.

scripts.check: node build.js --check && prettier --check src build.js desktop/main.js desktop/preload.js desktop/scripts tests playwright.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src build.js desktop/main.js desktop/preload.js desktop/scripts tests playwright.config.js && node build.js
